Let me follow the steps. Step 1: read notes.txt. Step 2: run node command. Step 3: create result.txt with PONG. Step 4: reply PONG.

Let me do steps 1 and 2 in parallel since they're independent.

notes: One turn exercising all three tool categories against a real opencode 1.18.21 over ACP: a read, a shell execute and an edit. Captured with scripts/capture-acp-trace.mjs, never hand-written.

opencode omits kind on the completing tool_call_update for all three tools. The category asserted on every completed event therefore proves the translator retains the category recorded when the tool started, rather than defaulting a kind-less completion to Other.
The tools interleave. The execute tool starts before the read completes, so the translator must track concurrent tool identities rather than assuming one open tool at a time.

Tool labels are rewritten on completion from the tool name to the target path. The asserted labels keep a real captured path and show the drive-qualified prefix removed at projection time, so this trace also covers redaction on a genuine absolute path.

opencode states the context window on usage_update and the input and output token split on the prompt result. Neither frame states both, so the turn-scoped usage snapshot joins the two stated facts and infers nothing; had the split never arrived, no usage would be recorded.

ACP has no message end, so the translator closes output itself: answer text after an untagged thought completes that thought block (a later thought opens the next block's item), and the completed prompt response completes the turn's still-open text, thought and plan items before the turn terminal.
